name: demo
comment: The ACCELERATED profile, for live demos only — never for a published number. Why it exists, stated plainly: at the calibrated 0.85% CTR a demo-scale run (300 shoppers x 20 days ~ 11,000 impressions) produces around 140 clicks and 2 purchases. Those are the RIGHT numbers and they make a dashboard that looks broken. This profile lowers the CLICK threshold so a demo produces visible events, and nothing else: BROWSE, CART and BUY stay exactly at their calibrated values, so everything below the click is still the certified funnel. The CLICK base is SOLVED for a stated target rate by shopsim.eval.calibrate.solve_stage_base rather than picked, and the resulting multiple on every metric is published in eval/results/calibration.json under demo_multiples. Solved value as of the r053 reference trace: CLICK 4.07 puts P(click|exposure) at 5.0%, a 5.6x acceleration on CTR and 1.0x on every other metric — bounce, cart|browse, buy|cart and visit-to-purchase all stay exactly where the reference profile put them, inside their published bands. Compare the profile this replaces, which multiplied CTR by ~22x and dragged everything below it with it. This replaces the ad-hoc {"stage_bases": {"CLICK": 2.0}} that was copy-pasted into spec files before Phase 7, which ran at ~28% CTR — roughly 22x the researched band, with a blended ROAS near 46x against a real-world 1.5-4x.
